names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Γάλλος», with the rank word left off. The page prints the Latin form beside it in its first sentence, «Ο Άγιος Γάλλος (Gall)».
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 15004, «Галл, прп.», with the rank word left off; the day line gives «Галла» and no epithet, no see and no country.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Галла (ок. 650).»
source.note: No rank is recorded: the line carries no service icon. The day's one service icon stands before Longinus the Centurion at the head of the paragraph and is that line's alone.

attestations.note: The same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Greek, and the same man — the one Western monk the Russian calendar keeps on this day. **It adds a year and takes nothing away, and it adds nothing else at all.** The line is «Прп. Галла (ок. 650)», about 650, against saint.gr's flat 646, and `dates` now carries the pair as an interval. There is no life link on the day line and his name page 15004 holds nothing but «Галл, прп.» and the one day, «День памяти: 16 октября» — no life, no other day, no hymn. The Russian prints no epithet for him either: not Steinach, not Ireland, not the abbey, so the folder's display name still rests on the Greek page alone.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Γάλλος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους» and «Αγιος Γαλλος (; - 646)», and the life states the death year again, «Κοιμήθηκε το 646 μ.Χ.», so `dates` carries a `death` of 646. **It does not carry a birth**: the page says «Γεννήθηκε λίγο μετά το 550 μ.Χ. στην Ιρλανδία», a little after 550, and there is no `display` shape in this corpus for that which `tests/dates-display.test.mjs` already recognises, so the statement is in the life and in this note instead of being rounded into one. The display name is built on the valley the page settles him in, «στην κοιλάδα του Στάιναχ», where the cells became the monastery of Saint Gall; the page's own «ο απόστολος της Ελβετίας» is a judgement it passes and not a title, and `types` is `["monk"]` because the only rank the page gives him is μοναχός — it says outright that he **refused** the bishopric of Constantia and put forward his disciple, the deacon John, for it, so there is no `office`. `locations` is left out as elsewhere on this reader's days. The page prints his name in both scripts, «Ο Άγιος Γάλλος (Gall)». Its «Κογγάλλος» at Bangor is the corpus's `comgall-of-bangor` and is in `related`; its Columbanus, «βλέπε 23 Νοεμβρίου», has no folder, so he is named in the life and not linked. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

Not in the Ohrid Prologue for 16 October old style as the Православни подсетник prints it (pravoslavno.rs for 29.10.2026, read 29 October 2026); its two entries that day are Longinus the martyr and Longinus the Labour-loving of the Kyiv Caves. No other day checked.

death.note: Two calendars, two years, and the interval carries both. saint.gr: «Κοιμήθηκε το 646 μ.Χ.», and its page head gives him as «Αγιος Γαλλος (; - 646)». days.pravoslavie.ru's day line for 16 октября ст. ст. gives «Прп. Галла (ок. 650)», about 650 — an approximation rather than a year, which is why the interval is bounded at it and not widened past it. For his birth saint.gr says only «Γεννήθηκε λίγο μετά το 550 μ.Χ. στην Ιρλανδία», a little after 550, which is not recorded as an interval here, and the Russian page gives no birth at all.
